name: Commands
author: Coen Spoor
description: Start and stop long-running commands from the bar. Saved commands get a toggle; anything typed in runs once. Each runs as a transient systemd user unit with its own journal.

barWidget.description: Toggle saved long-running commands or run a one-off, each as a systemd user unit.
